name: Spondylolisthesis in Adolescents
definition: Anterior translation of a vertebra, usually L5 on S1 in adolescents, often related to pars defects and repetitive extension loading.

investigations.principle: Standing lateral radiographs assess slip grade; MRI/CT are selected for pars/stress and neural questions.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Core/hamstring rehabilitation for stable low-grade slips
amber: High-grade or progressive symptomatic slips require pediatric spine surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati/Asthi-Sandhi phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Anterior translation of a vertebra, usually L5 on S1 in adolescents, often related to pars defects and repetitive extension loading.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
